info.name: Codestra OpenBao native read-only contract
info.description: Read-only checks mapped to codestra/api/service-contract.v1.json operation IDs. Run only against a disposable or explicitly approved target. The token is supplied at run time with --env-var baoToken=...; it is never stored in this collection or an environment file.

item.name: health: state is reported through the status code

exec: pm.test('active, initialized and unsealed', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.initialized).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.sealed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });

item.name: mounts-list: metadata only, codestra KV v2 present

exec: pm.test('codestra/ is KV v2', () => { const m = pm.response.json().data['codestra/']; pm.expect(m.type).to.eql('kv'); pm.expect(m.options.version).to.eql('2'); });

item.name: kv-config-read: planned retention and CAS read back

exec: pm.test('CAS required, ten versions, 2160h retention', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.cas_required).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.max_versions).to.eql(10); pm.expect(d.delete_version_after).to.eql('2160h0m0s'); });

item.name: policy-read: managed workload policy is read-only and environment-bound

exec: pm.test('no write capability and other environments denied', () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.policy; pm.expect(p).to.not.match(/"(create|update|delete|sudo)"/); pm.expect(p).to.include('codestra/data/production/*'); pm.expect(p).to.include('"deny"'); });
